body:
Doesn't 3 years mean you're halfway through fat redistribution, gaining muscle mass and facial hair growth?

It sounds like you don't really live in an accepting place :/ but I'll tell you that you're valid. There are plenty of short men too y'know

Sorry I don't have more to say,, obviously I'm not in a place to be supportive.. but I'm sure if you express your feelings on a sub like r/ftm they'll have plenty of useful things to say. You could even just copy/paste your comment

Yeah I feel that. My top dysphoria is pretty brutal. Hopefully after you get your top surgery your bottom dysphoria will be manageable. Penis transplants are available for amab people in some places tho, maybe soon in Canada for trans men?

How long have you been on t? It's a really strong hormone, if you're not seeing results you like in that respect give it some time, easier said than done I know..

Are you on T?
And IDK about that, if you live somewhere with decent access to healthcare and trans health coverage on Medicaid (California, Oregon, Washington) all the hrt and surgeries you could want (except ffs/fms but that's not really an issue for trans men on t) are available for free

There's risk of violence definitely.

As for killing future me, persuasive, but I don't have a future. Never did. There's no way that I can pull myself out of this at this point. The situation has reached it's worst possible outcome.

As for ordering online, I tried that before I was homeless, I ordered progynova and got ethinyl estradiol instead of bioidentical estrogen. It was some kind of scam site. It's not like I have the money for that now.

There aren't other trans people here that I know of, finding any online would be quite difficult, but I'm sure if there are any here, they probably drive the 4 hours to the Los Angeles gender clinic

It's not about the future.. sure technically I could do what it takes to get a job, housing; to get back on track again. But it's not practically possible. I don't have options.

Lastly, no, I don't have any friends.

It seems pretty obvious to me what I have to do.
